notes.title: Update Notes For May 17
notes.content:
We have uploaded a patch to fix some errors in the game. Mainly, it addresses occasional crashes. Additionally, we have also made some minor improvements to the interface.

Here is a list of the main bug fixes:

- Fixed bug when consuming poison.
- Fixed bug when visiting a grave.
- Fixed bug in the counter-reaction panel.
- Fixed bug when interacting with someone while lightning kills him.
- Fixed bug when user retries mission 2.

notes.title: Minabo - A Walk Through Life Gameplay with Kimchica
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41542547/9e2b9ca924e25330b698ccab6f2e910cbf4c6004.jpg

Minabo - A Walk Through Life is a cosy indie title where players have to grow their own turnip and experience its whole circle of life from beginning to end by interacting with other turnips and the environment. Make friends, create a family, and take care of pets to establish relationships in quick playthroughs.
 
As life progresses, players will have to make hard decisions regarding their social interactions. Would they marry a turnip and have children, or would they rather stay single and take care of their parents in their final days? Minabo - A Walk Through Life is a pure (and hard) life metaphor!
 
Players will enjoy appealing visuals and charming characters for all audiences while completing 25 quests full of life-changing moments inspired by psychologist counselors involved in the development. Replay with Free Life Mode to change the path again, and share their life story on social media.
 

 Minabo - A Walk Through Life available now on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PC, PS4 and PS5
 New indie cozy video game with cute characters
 If you like simulation games, take a look at Minabo - A Walk Through Life
